finalText:
Here's your 4-day Pembrokeshire Coast Path plan based in St Davids: Whitesands and St Davids Head on day 1, Porthgain to the Blue Lagoon on day 2, the Solva to Caerfai stage on day 3, and the Marloes Sands circuit to finish.

On conditions: the live weather lookup is unavailable right now, but no matter — early May in Pembrokeshire brings average highs of 18°C and overnight lows of 9°C, with only around 60 mm of rain across the month, so you can count on dry, warm walking. Guesthouses in St Davids run about £75 a night. Want me to add the Skomer boat crossing?
